in_marathi.name: Brinda
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Flowers
in_marathi.long_meaning: Brinda हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Brinda is the name of a celestial nymph, a maiden of the forest, who is enamored of Lord Shiva. She is often depicted as a beautiful and graceful maiden, holding a lotus flower in her hand. Brinda was a devoted devotee of Lord Shiva and performed severe penance to attain his love. The God of Gods, Lord Shiva, was pleased by her devotion and granted her the boon of eternal love.
